covered_report_window: Friday, September 25, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Monday, September 28, 2026 before the U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: U.S. equities were modestly higher intraday, but the event backdrop remained rate-sensitive after the Federal Reserve's September hike. The 10-year Treasury yield had exceeded 5%, oil remained elevated, and September consumer sentiment weakened as one-year inflation expectations rose to 4.6%. These conditions raise financing and valuation risk especially for small, speculative issuers.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

consensus_method.pass_scope: All three independent passes received the same shared qualified universe, which was empty after the pre-pass screen.
consensus_method.disparity_definition: Disparity is a 0-100 measure of distance among the three passes' direction and reversal-risk outputs; lower means tighter agreement. It is not computable when no ticker qualifies.
consensus_method.strongest_names_disparity: Not applicable; there were no qualified names.
consensus_method.pass_agreement: Complete agreement at the universe stage: no ticker met the standing inclusion threshold.
consensus_method.lessons_review: The cumulative lessons reinforced timing hygiene, key-metric-first analysis, expectation-bar checks, and separate reversal-risk calibration. No new method change was warranted for this run.
